Name: Deck for Genetec Security Desk
Author: Pavel Kotyza
Description: Genetec Security Desk's keyboard shortcuts on Stream Deck keys: play / pause, frame step, rewind / forward, bookmarks, instant replay, live / playback, alarm acknowledge and snooze, tile navigation and patterns, PTZ and presets, door unlock, hot actions — plus any entity by logical ID. Windows natively; on a Mac through Parallels, VMware or Remote Desktop. Ready-made profiles for Stream Deck, Mini and XL. Independent project, not affiliated with Genetec Inc. or Elgato. https://www.4xs.dev

Actions.Name: Security Desk Command
Actions.Tooltip: Sends one Genetec Security Desk shortcut to the front window: camera playback, alarms, tiles, PTZ, doors, hot actions, general. Defaults are Genetec's documented shortcuts; editable per key.

Actions.Name: Security Desk Hotkey
Actions.Tooltip: Sends any shortcut or sequence with your own title — <logical ID> Enter displays a camera or entity in the selected tile, <n> Shift+Insert goes to a PTZ preset, <ID> Ctrl+Enter starts a camera sequence.

Actions.Name: Activate Security Desk
Actions.Tooltip: Brings Security Desk to the front so the next shortcut lands in it — the client window on Windows; on a Mac the app hosting it (Parallels Desktop, VMware Fusion, Windows App).
